description: Answers a buyer question such as "best AI agency for Shopify in Europe" or "n8n agency in the UK for healthcare" from Cofounderbase data, with a short answer and links to each company's Cofounderbase profile. Ranked by match and public evidence score, never by payment. Before 5 December 2026 it uses public directory listings only; after that it also marks award nominees with their AI scorecard.

category.description: Optional award, to list nominees of one award only (from 5 December 2026).

country.description: Optional country or region, for example "Germany" or "Europe".

industry.description: Optional industry, for example Healthcare, E-commerce, Real estate.

platform.description: Optional tool, for example n8n, Zapier, HubSpot, Vapi.

question.description: The buyer question in plain English.

name: awards_ask_jury

message.description: One or two sentences to show the user as they are.
